pretreatments.description: Grinding of C. papayas fruit peels into ≤20 mm mesh sizes using a hammer mill.
Thermal treatment at 80°C for 60 minutes using a water bath.
Chemical treatment using 3 g NaOH for 100 g TS at 55°C for 24 hours.
Application of mechanical breakdown without thermo-alkaline pretreatments.
Combination of mechanical breakdown followed by thermo-alkaline pretreatments.
Application of thermo-alkaline pretreatment at 80°C for 60 minutes followed by chemical treatment with 3 g NaOH for 100 g TS at 55°C for 24 hours.
Application of thermo-alkaline pretreatment at 55°C for 24 hours with solid loading of 35 g TS/L.
